meta.title: Preguntas hostiles e
meta.goal: Puedes mantener el turno, corregir premisas y responder preguntas adversariales con precisión y compostura.

cards.title: Identifica la presión real
cards.lede: Una pregunta difícil puede contener una duda legítima, una premisa falsa o un intento de desplazar el tema.

rows.value: How can you be sure the savings are real?
Why did you ignore the safety warnings?
Do you care more about profit or employees?
Why discuss this when last year’s project also failed?

cards.title: Compra tiempo sin parecer evasivo
cards.lede: Una pausa verbal breve te permite estructurar la respuesta y señalar qué parte abordarás.

rows.value: There are two issues in that question. Let me take the cost estimate first.
Before I answer, I want to clarify what we mean by “failure.”
I can speak to the operational decision; I can’t comment on the legal review.
That’s an important concern. Here’s what we know so far.

cards.title: Corrige la premisa antes de responder
cards.lede: Aceptar la gramática de una pregunta puede hacerte admitir algo que no ocurrió.

lines.text: We ignored the warnings because we were under pressure.
I don’t accept the premise that the warnings were ignored. Two were addressed immediately; the third is still under review.
Of course we care about employees more than profit.
Safety and financial stability are both constraints; the decision has to meet both.

cards.title: Recupera la palabra con firmeza
cards.lede: No necesitas competir en volumen; marca una frontera breve y promete espacio para responder.

columns.label: Recuperación
columns.rule: Protege el turno y reconoce al interlocutor.
examples: Let me finish this point, and then I’ll come directly to your question.
I want to hear that concern; give me ten seconds to complete the timeline.

cards.title: Responde y vuelve al punto central
cards.lede: Un puente legítimo contesta la pregunta antes de conectar con el mensaje relevante.

rows.value: No, the estimate does not include the second phase.
That phase has a separate approval process.
What the current estimate does show is that phase one is within budget.
What really matters is our commitment to excellence.

cards.title: Deja una respuesta verificable
cards.lede: Bajo presión, termina con un hecho, un límite o un compromiso de seguimiento concreto.

rows.value: The audit covers all transactions through June 30.
We do not yet know whether the issue affected July records.
We will publish the July review on Monday.
Does that answer the timing part of your question?

tip.label: Secuencia:
tip.body: pausa, diagnostica, corrige si hace falta, responde y cierra con algo comprobable.

options: We ignored it because we were busy.
I don’t accept that the warning was ignored; two actions were completed that day.
quiz.explain: Rechaza la premisa y la sustituye por hechos específicos.

quiz.q: ¿Cuál frase recupera el turno sin escalar?
options: Let me finish this point, and then I’ll come directly to your question.
quiz.explain: Marca una frontera y garantiza que la preocupación será atendida.

options: Responde primero y luego conecta con el punto relevante
quiz.explain: La conexión no sustituye una respuesta directa.
